body.prompt: A Korean woman in her forties lying awake in bed at night in a dark bedroom, eyes open, staring at the ceiling, replaying something in her mind, faint light from the window. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame, faces clearly lit. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
